issues.reason: Comparatives states a comparative does not entail the positive ('taller-than-Y doesn't make X tall'), so both the flat (Member sk_shares_1 low) and the reified low state falsely assert that $28.12 shares are low.
Measures fixes the scale as the surface dimension ('Record what's said'), and 'decrease' appears nowhere in the sentence — the stated dimension word is the comparative 'lower'.

Before is a licensed closed-class head over two eventualities the text asserts, and the result infinitive 'to end at $28.12' states exactly that sequence, so the ordering is true and well-typed improvisation in the reviewer's own result-infinitive gap.

Real that a 'with'-absolute participle is not among the four enumerated Ongoing markers, but overstated as a defect — the -ing is progressive morphology (Perception reports reads a bare participial -ing as exactly that) and the atom is true of the edging, so it stands under the calibration line.
Measure's first slot is the entity that bears the dimension (only 'duration' is defined on an event), and the ending event is not priced at $28.12 — the shares are.
Names and casing requires a multi-word name to be one opaque symbol built from the whole name, and 'nyse' is an acronym the text never uses.

gaps_confirmed: Absolute 'with NP V-ing' adjunct: the 'with'-phrase rules cover only comitative CoAgent and Instrument NPs, so the participial clause has no licensed link to the matrix event.
Differential comparative with an implicit standard ('edging 7 cents lower'): MoreBy requires an explicit 'than Y'.
Result infinitive ('to end at $28.12'): only purpose infinitives (To / InOrderTo) are covered, and result-vs-purpose is not distinguished.
Extent / downtoner adverb on an event ('reacted little'): only a plain Manner filler is available, losing the near-negative force.
Episodic bare-plural subject ('Investors reacted ...'): bare plurals route to generic rules, with no stated route for a bare plural naming specific participants in a one-off past event.
new_gaps: Aspect of a participial absolute: the four Ongoing markers do not include it, although the instruction set treats a bare participial -ing as a progressive marker for perception complements.

A bare change-magnitude on an event ('edged 7 cents lower') has no carrier at all: Measure's scale must be the surface dimension and its entity slot is for entities, while MoreBy needs an explicit standard — so the figure can only be dropped.
repair_summary: Removed the reified low state, its Experiencer and the flat (Member sk_shares_1 low), plus the now-dangling (Result sk_edge_1 sk_low_1) that referenced the deleted witness; removed (Measure sk_edge_1 decrease 7 cent) — no licensed form exists for a differential with an implicit standard; moved the price measure onto the shares and kept the clause's pastness as the tense wrapper Measures prescribes; renamed nyse to new_york_stock_exchange in all three atoms.
notes: Removing the 7-cent figure and the 'lower' comparison leaves the price change unrecorded, which is the honest outcome of the implicit-standard gap. The Ongoing and Before atoms were left untouched as true gap-territory improvisation.
